newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 1.38 million barrels in the week ended April 18 to 312.79 million barrels from 311.41 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 161,000 barrels in the week to 248.82 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 4.68 million barrels to 96.30 million barrels from 100.97 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 2.12 million barrels to 29.04 million barrels.
It said gasoline production rose 337,000 barrels in the week to 7.74 million bpd from 7.41 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 1.95 million barrels in the week to 194.59 million barrels from a revised 196.53 million barrels that was previously reported as 199.62 million.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 93.5 percent from 93.6 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 658,000 barrels to 35.77 million barrels from 35.11 million barrels the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.28 million barrels from 14.21 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 41.60 million barrels from 40.47 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 7.98 million barrels per day from 7.82 million, API said.
